name: Suwa Munechika
source:
"From the looks of it, you've learned well."

Well-trusted by the students, she is the instructor in Chivalry at Ginran Academy. When she was young, she studied abroad at Arianrhod Girls' Academy, and was chosen as the best knight "Brillante" because of her talent. She has known [url=/c124986]Nina[/url] since their days at the school. Suwa is [url=/c124651]Hina[/url]'s cousin and also his fencing teacher.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.ensemble-game.com/29.otohime/character_munechika.html]official website[/url]]
